prompt_en: White mounds of salt lined up in rows on a salt field under the midday sun.
refined_prompt: White mounds of salt lined up in rows on a salt field under the midday sun. In coastal Vietnam, salt fields known as "ruộng muối" are vast expanses where salt is traditionally harvested under the scorching midday sun. White mounds of salt are neatly lined up in rows, reflecting the sun’s light in dazzling brilliance. The tradition of salt production, dating back to early dynastic periods, is integral to Vietnamese coastal communities, reflecting the country’s deep agricultural heritage and the importance of salt to its economy and cuisine. Salt workers meticulously harvest the precious crystals that flavor traditional dishes and support local communities.
